answer: Reputation decays 25 percent per idle epoch, and a duplicate submission forfeits the bond outright. Failure one: a farm that stops to regroup loses a quarter of its standing every epoch it waits. Failure two: a copy-paste batch trips the replay check in the kernel and zeroes 100 seats at once. Numbers: 6 idle epochs leave 18 percent weight, and one duplicate costs 500 POA. An island of parked accounts is worth nothing after 8 epochs. A comet of activity pauses the clock, it does not reset it.
